units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|The Unfettered have clearly noticed that you have a jump drive; a large crowd of them has gathered around your ship. Do you want to talk with them, and perhaps arrange a sale of your jump drive?|152|0

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|	As soon as you approach the crowd, one of them steps forward and says, "One million credits, and the friendship of the true Hai people. This is our offer, for the jump drive."|157|0

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|	"Sure, I will accept that deal."|159|0
units.english: "Sure, I will accept that deal."

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|	"Can you offer me more than that?"|161|0

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|	"We can give you a hyperdrive in its place, if required," they say, "and you will be counted as our friend, so you will not need to leave here quickly, or under threat of violence." You can't help but wonder if they will try to take your ship by force if you do not agree to the deal.|165|0

units.id: mission:Unfettered Jump Drive 1|	The Unfettered engineers quickly and carefully remove your jump drive and replace it with an ordinary hyperdrive. You sincerely hope that you are not making a mistake by giving them this new technology. "Remember," one of them says as they hand you your payment, "when you acquire more jump drives, return here with them and we will give you further rewards. Until then, may fortune favor you, human friend."|198|0
